headline: The play-scorer is live: RL partner v4 closes on the CPU, and a one-line baseline dethrones the models' headline metric
lede: Stage 3a (#2409) shipped in retrogames-rl: playscore.mjs seats any partner in the real Gauntlet sim and prints the full signal list with commit provenance. Fresh validation says cpu > v4 > v3 >> idle — and that repeat-last-tick beats every trained model on raw pad accuracy, so the next trainer optimizes the honest gates instead.

notes.text: #2409 shipped (retrogames-rl ff40b26): playscore.mjs + self-test 9/9 incl. a poisoned-attribution mutant; kill attribution solved via monsterHit.via/potion stamps — hunter/breaker goals are now safe signals.

Gate honesty: repeat-last-tick pad 0.9177 held-out beats v3/v4 — teacher-forcing padAcc has been measuring button-holding since stage 1. score.mjs now leads changed-row pad + swing F1; 3b (#2515) trains against those.
v4 (trained on the 3090, picked on a carved validation split — the rule-4 fix) beats v3 on held-out pad AND swing F1 with 16% less data, and plays noticeably closer to the CPU partner.
Win rate is saturated at default difficulty (cpu sweeps with hero hp never under 27%), so stage 3c will raise levelCount rather than trust wins. Queue stays full: #2515, #2516 filed.
